caption: The drawing depicts a large, rounded jug with a narrow neck and a single handle attached to the top. The jug appears to be made of ceramic or stoneware and is rendered in various shades of gray and light brown, with blue highlights around the handle and mouth, and on some decorative elements. On the body of the jug, there are two stylized bird figures, outlined in dark blue and filled with lighter blue shading, standing on branches or ground. One bird is facing left, standing atop a branch with leaves, while the other faces right and is perched on a round object. The jug itself is centrally positioned within a box-like outline on the page. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a detailed inset of the handle and neck of the jug, shown from the side and featuring blue shading, also placed within a separate outline. The background is plain and uncolored, with the illustration keeping focus on the object.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
